name: Out Of Stock Badge
author: Arrow Design

sections.description:
Out Of Stock Badge automatically adds an Out of Stock badge to unavailable WooCommerce products.

Free functionality includes:

  • Automatic Out of Stock badge
  • Custom badge text
  • Background colour
  • Text colour
  • Admin preview

Out Of Stock Badge Pro is an optional, separately installed commercial add-on available from Arrow Design. The Pro code and licence system are not included in this WordPress.org plugin.

Pro adds Low Stock, Backorder and Sale badges, advanced styling and positioning, display controls, WooCommerce sale-flash control and per-product badge overrides.

A 7-day trial of Out Of Stock Badge Pro is available from Arrow Design.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Out Of Stock Badge.
  2. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  3. Go to Settings > Out Of Stock Badge.
  4. Configure the badge.
  5. The Pro Features tab explains the optional separately installed Pro add-on.
sections.faq:
Does the free plugin require a licence?

No. The free Out Of Stock Badge plugin does not contain a licence system and does not require payment or an external account.

Is Pro included but locked inside this plugin?

No. Out Of Stock Badge Pro is a separate add-on plugin distributed outside WordPress.org.

Will updating from an older release break my badge?

The plugin retains and migrates the historical free badge settings used by earlier versions.
